column1: # Forgotten Worlds (CPS1 `forgottn`) ARRANGE trigger map -> PC Engine CD-ROM2
# CD-DA (Japan disc), the internal listening archive
# THE JOIN IS MACHINE-NAMED AT BOTH ENDS, no ordinal guessing:
#  * arcade side: 95 commands isolated per-boot (svc_isolate + PIN_CFG -- the
#    service DIP round-trips through cfg and a Lua field write flips it, so the
#    batched sweep had 71/94 windows contaminated).  Every sustained command
#    NCC-named against the reference arcade gamerip (SAME carrier), r 0.16-0.97
#    with clean margins; in-game anchors: attract=0x01 (r 0.608 vs its own
#    isolated clip), stage-1 start fires 0x02 (latch + audio agree).
#  * PCE side: every CD track named by DURATION against the reference PCE rip
#    (err <= 0.5 s on all 23 named tracks), consistent with the cue table
#  * the two fail-open jingle groups are CONFIRMED missing from the CD by the
#    rip itself: its curator titled them "Not on CD 1" / "Not on CD 2".
# LOOPING: PCE plays BGM with CD_PLAY mode 1 (drive-side infinite whole-track
# repeat) -> whole-track loops, no crossfade (internal PCE CD loop research).
# Jingles (opening / round clear / game over) are one-shot.
# 0x0e is the two-phase last boss: PCE plays tr06 (Bios intro, 22.7 s) then
# tr07 (main, 180.7 s); the pack track is the CONCATENATION with the loop over
# the tr07 portion, so the intro plays once and the main theme repeats.
# Ending: tr21 (voiced, IDENTICAL on both region discs -- measured,
# 21 of 23 tracks bit-identical, only tr01 warning + tr22 narration differ).
# User choice over the instrumental tr24 and over tr22, whose English
# narration was rejected by ear.  The ffight desync caution was weighed and
# accepted: tr21's narration is not region-gated, so it never mismatches.
